summary.text: McKay Erickson is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 21, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: McKay Erickson earned a bachelor's degree from Utah State University in 1992, and Erickson's career experience includes working as an educator and in timber and powerline services.
Erickson assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 6, 2025, succeeding Lane Allred.
For 2025-2026, Erickson's committee assignments include the House Education Committee and the Select Federal Natural Resource Management Committee.
